# Research package TECH-SOURCES-001 — engineering source research (protocol of record)

**Do not edit this file during a run.** Only the Lead session changes it, on Owner direction.

## Identity and authority
- Base: `feature/atomic-json-session-persistence` at `7eeb08577f59ecb88f4694dd1b16cae3049b5749` (Merge PR #888), live tip verified 2026-10-27.
- Branch: `research/tech-sources-001`. Writes ONLY under `research/tech-sources-001/`. No PR, no merge, no deployment.
- Authority: Owner-accepted research setup (2026-10-27). Research starts ONLY when `state/campaign-status.md` reads `ACTIVE`;
  the Lead sets that after the preflight passes and the Owner's bounded campaign authorization is effective. A run never sets `ACTIVE` itself.
- This package is evidence only (D13 conventions: provenance register, abstention log, unresolved issues, per-question findings,
  owner-readable summary). It closes no gate, admits no method, activates no capability (D4 and every deferred capability stay inactive),
  and never edits production source, `domains/**`, `domains/domain_provenance.json`, `docs/governance/**`, `engine/`, `web/` or `tests/`.
- D13 stays PAUSED: no X-3 sensor ↔ controller specialist research and no Sensors C3 research without separate Owner authorization.

## Source and IP boundary (CLAUDE.md Technical Knowledge & IP Source Boundary; research-scout rule)
- Perplexity is source discovery only. A claim counts only after its primary source is fetched directly and recorded:
  publisher / authority, exact identity (title, number, edition / version, date), URL, section and page, retrieval date, SHA-256.
- Record the reuse basis per source in `evidence/ip-and-reuse-register.md`. Unknown or incompatible rights → abstain and record the open IP question.
  Publicly viewable ≠ lawfully reusable. Third-party material inside a usable source is assessed separately. Never copy protected expression.
- Never invent a value, threshold, criterion or source claim. A finding is at most `QUALIFIED-CANDIDATE` — never admitted, never adopted.

## Query privacy rule (checked before EVERY external call)
Queries are built ONLY from the exact-claim text of `state/question-register.md` plus generic technical terms.
Never include inventor, user, project or session content, nor text from `docs/validation/**`, study corpora, session logs, ILT ledgers or any database.
If a query would need such content, do not send it; record an abstention.

## Six adaptive search lenses (Owner-agreed source-discovery methods)
1. Principle-based · 2. Technology-based · 3. Function-based · 4. Problem-based · 5. Application-based · 6. Source-targeted.
Choose lenses adaptively per question; record the lens used for every query in the run ledger. They are discovery methods, not READ BEFORE BUILD checks.

## Limits (fixed; never expanded by a run)
- Per run: at most 3 questions worked; at most 12 Perplexity calls, of which at most 1 `perplexity_research`; at most 15 direct primary-source fetches.
- Per question: at most 20 queries in total; after 3 runs without progress → `BLOCKED` with the exact reason.
- Campaign: at most 20 research runs, 30 days from activation, 240 queries — whichever first. The preflight counts as no run and uses no query.

## Run protocol (each scheduled wake-up)
1. `git fetch origin research/tech-sources-001` and work on that branch at its remote tip. Confirm this README's base line is unchanged.
2. Read `state/campaign-status.md`. If it is not `ACTIVE`: do no search and no push; if it is `STOPPED`, try step 7 (disable); end the run.
3. Re-read the live authority text on `feature/atomic-json-session-persistence` (`CLAUDE.md` Current authority, `docs/governance/ACTIVE_INCREMENT_CONTRACT.md`
   first Current-authority section). If it materially changes this research (pause, revocation, a register question delivered or settled), stop (step 7).
4. If `research/tech-sources-001/STOP` exists, stop (step 7).
5. Work at most 3 `QUEUED` / `IN_PROGRESS` questions in register order, within the limits; Tier 2 questions only after every Tier 1 question is terminal.
6. Record: sources, IP basis, abstentions, blocked hosts (never retry a host that returned 403 in the same run), findings, contradictions;
   append one run-ledger row (date, run number, questions, queries per lens, fetches, cumulative totals, outcome). Commit and push. A push that fails twice → stop.
7. Stop conditions: every question terminal; any limit reached; 3 runs in a row without progress; STOP file; authority change; branch / base mismatch;
   push failed twice; Perplexity connector missing (never substitute another method). To stop: write `STOPPED: <reason>` to `state/campaign-status.md`,
   commit and push, then call `list_triggers`, find the task named `InventorAI research TECH-SOURCES-001` and `update_trigger` it with `enabled=false`.
   If that call is unavailable or fails, record it in `state/campaign-status.md`; every later wake-up then ends at step 2 without searching.

## Preflight protocol (run only when the wake-up text says PREFLIGHT ONLY)
No Perplexity call, no source fetch, no research. Record each check as PASS / FAIL with evidence in `state/preflight.md`:
- P1 branch: on `research/tech-sources-001` at the remote tip; README base line present.
- P2 resumption: the scheduled wake-up reached this dedicated session (state the session id and the wake-up text received).
- P3 connector: Perplexity Research tools are available (load their schemas with ToolSearch; do NOT call them).
- P4 persistence / push: commit `state/preflight.md` and push it to `research/tech-sources-001`; report the pushed SHA; note any permission prompt.
- P5 stopping: `list_triggers` shows the task `InventorAI research TECH-SOURCES-001`; call `update_trigger` with `enabled=false` on it and
  confirm it reads disabled (this also holds the schedule until the Owner's campaign authorization). Record the result, commit and push again.
- P6 privacy: confirm no external query was sent during the preflight.
Do not change `state/campaign-status.md`.
